about_the_game:
Meet your new virtual pet, Chibi! Do your best to keep it alive and reveal all its secrets!

Game Features:

  • Care for your virtual pet just like in the toys of the 2000s. Feed it, put it to sleep, play with it, and treat it on time to prevent it from dying.

  • Realistic toy-like representation. Press buttons on the device with your pet, change batteries, and fix it. Other retro gaming devices will also appear in the game, helping you interact with your pet, solve puzzles, and progress through the storyline.

  • Two game modes: "Real-Time." Your pet lives according to your rhythm. Care for your pet throughout the real day, put it to sleep at night, and feed it on time. If it doesn't die, the next day it will advance the storyline or reveal a piece of the secrets it hides. "Accelerated Mode" is for those who want to complete the game right now. Time in the game will be significantly sped up, allowing you to progress through the storyline in just a few hours.

  • Uncover mysteries and solve tricky meta-puzzles to learn all the secrets of your new friend. You'll have to think hard and use clever tricks to unravel the story behind this game.

  • The game is not as cute and simple as it seems at first glance. Behind the facade of a cute virtual pet lies a dark story that will gradually unfold throughout the game.

And most importantly, remember, never say the word "Cryptolight" to Chibi!!!
